kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نعتصم (form VIII)
# نَعْتَصِمُ (naʕtaṣimu) /naʕ.ta.sˤi.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# نُعْتَصَمُ (nuʕtaṣamu) /nuʕ.ta.sˤa.mu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# نَعْتَصِمَ (naʕtaṣima) /naʕ.ta.sˤi.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# نُعْتَصَمَ (nuʕtaṣama) /nuʕ.ta.sˤa.m
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
